title: An agent cannot post a file whose path starts with the home shortcut
whatHappens: A person asks their agent for a file; the agent saves it under ~/ and the post fails as file not found, so the person gets no file.

observations.text: Friction and feedback, outside, 1 Nov: 1 person, 2 reports at 10:46 UTC; the attach path resolver never expands ~/. Not fixed on main; no open PR. New.

fixes.text: Expand the home shortcut in attachment paths; fix corner opened 1 Nov
